query:
SELECT access_level::text
        FROM entity_access
        WHERE entity_id = $2
        AND entity_type = 'chat'
        AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM entity_access_source_matches(source_id, $1, NULL::uuid))
        ORDER BY
            CASE access_level::text
                WHEN 'owner' THEN 4
                WHEN 'edit' THEN 3
                WHEN 'comment' THEN 2
                WHEN 'view' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END DESC
        LIMIT 1
